sentences.text: Zhuchengceratops is an extinct ceratopsian dinosaur belonging to the family Leptoceratopsidae that lived in modern-day China during the Upper Cretaceous.
This animal possessed a particularly massive and deep mandible that was 50 centimeters long and thin transversely.
The genus Zhuchengceratops was first described in 2010 by Xu et al. with the type species Zhuchengceratops inexpectus.
